blocks.text: Qizil kitobda (→ qizil kitob, 70-dars) **the sun**, **the same**, **the radio**, play **the guitar** kabi iboralarni ko'rgan edik. Ularning hammasi 72-darsdagi bitta mantiqqa bo'ysunadi: gaplashayotganlarning umumiy dunyosida narsa **bitta** bo'lsa, «qaysi biri?» degan savol tug'ilmaydi — demak **the**. Bu darsda ro'yxatni kengaytiramiz (the government, the climate, the media) va eng muhimi — istisnolarni ko'ramiz: yagona narsa qachon **a** oladi (**a full moon**), qaysi «yagona» so'zlar the siz keladi (**space**, **nature**), va raqamli nomlarda nega the yo'q (**Room 214**).

items.text: **The sky** over the desert was full of stars.
**The government** has banned plastic bags in supermarkets.
Prices on **the internet** are often lower than in shops.

blocks.text: a full moon, a better world — sifat bilan a / an

Yagona narsaning **bir holatini yoki turini** sifat bilan tasvirlaganda **a / an** keladi. Oy bitta — **the moon**, lekin uning ko'rinishlari ko'p: **a full moon** (to'lin oy), **a new moon**. Dunyo bitta — **the world**, lekin biz orzu qilayotgan dunyo — «mumkin bo'lgan dunyolardan biri»: **a better world**. Hukumat bitta — **the government**, lekin saylovdan keyin — **a new government**. Sifatsiz, oddiy ma'noda esa yana **the**: **The moon** is bright tonight.

items.text: We want **a cleaner environment** for our children.
The country has **a new government** now.

blocks.text: Yagonaga o'xshaydi, lekin the siz: space, nature, TV, Room 214

Ba'zi so'zlar ma'nosi bo'yicha yagona ko'rinsa ham, umumiy ma'noda **the** olmaydi. **space** (koinot, fazo): travel **into space**, life **in space** — lekin **the universe**. **nature** (tabiat): I love **nature**; **the nature of** ... esa «... ning mohiyati, xususiyati». **society**, **history**, **life** ham umumiy ma'noda the siz (→ 75-dars). Televizor ham shunday: watch **TV**, on **TV** — lekin listen to **the radio**. Raqamli nomlarda ham the yo'q: raqam otdan **keyin** kelsa — **Room 214**, **Gate 7**, **page 52**; tartib son otdan **oldin** kelsa — **the fifth floor**, **the second chapter**.
the same — va uning atrofidagi iboralar

**same** doim **the** bilan (→ qizil kitob, 70-dars). B1–B2 darajada uning qoliplari muhim: **the same** + ot + **as** (the same phone **as** mine), **the same** + ot + **that / who** (the same man **who** helped us), **the same thing**, **at the same time** (bir vaqtning o'zida), **all the same** (baribir). E'tibor bering: «o'xshash» va «boshqa» yagona emas, shuning uchun **a similar** problem, **a different** dish — «the similar» deyilmaydi.

items.text: Her dress is **the same colour as** mine.

blocks.text: the cinema, the radio, the news — lekin TV

go to **the cinema** / **the theatre** deganda aniq bir bino emas, **ko'ngilochar faoliyat** nazarda tutiladi — shuning uchun shahardagi kinoteatrlar soni ahamiyatsiz. Axborot manbalari ham the bilan: on **the radio**, on **the internet** (lekin **online** — the siz), watch **the news**, **the media**, **the press**, read **the papers**. Kundalik joylar ham shu mantiqda: go to **the shops** (xarid qilgani), go to **the gym**. Televizor — istisno: watch **TV**, on **TV**; **the TV** esa faqat apparatning o'zi: Turn off **the TV**.
the sea, the mountains, the countryside

Tabiiy muhit turlari — dengiz bo'yi, tog', qishloq joy, sohil, cho'l, o'rmon — **the** bilan: go to **the seaside**, live by **the sea**, a holiday in **the mountains**, live in **the countryside** (yoki **the country** — «qishloq joy» ma'nosida). O'zbekchada «Tog'ga dam olgani bordik» — qaysi tog' ekani aytilmaydi, inglizchada esa baribir **the mountains**: bu «tog'li joy» degan umumiy muhit. Transport sifatida esa — **by sea** (dengiz orqali), the siz; **at sea**, **go to sea** kabi iboralar — 74-darsda.

items.text: We spent a week in **the mountains**.
I'd love to live in **the countryside**.

blocks.text: British English'da musiqa asboblari **the** bilan: play **the** piano, learn **the** violin, play **the** dutar / **the** doira. Amerika ingliz tilida va pop, jazz musiqachilari nutqida «play guitar» ham uchraydi, lekin **the** bilan variant har doim xavfsiz. Sport va o'yinlar — artiklsiz: play tennis, play chess. Raqam qo'shilgan nomlar esa yagona bo'lsa ham the olmaydi: **Room 214**, **Platform 4**, **Row 12**, **Ward 6** — raqamning o'zi «qaysi biri» degan savolga javob berib qo'ygan.

items.text: Aziz plays **the doira** in a folk band.
Our flat is on **the fourth floor**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Government decided ...» → **The government** decided; «I want to fly to the space» → **into space**; «I love the nature» → **I love nature**; «We have same problem» → **the same problem**; «It's the similar problem» → **a similar problem**; «I saw it in the TV» → **on TV**; «I heard it on radio» → **on the radio**; «We went to mountains» → **to the mountains**; «Go to the room 214» → **Go to Room 214**; «She plays piano» (British English) → **She plays the piano**.

Tekshirish: gaplashayotganlarning umumiy dunyosida bu narsa **bitta**mi? Ha → **the** (the sun, the government). Lekin uning **qanaqa ekanini** sifat bilan tasvirlayotgan bo'lsangiz → **a** (a full moon). Raqam otdan **keyin** kelsa → the yo'q (Room 5); tartib son otdan **oldin** kelsa → **the** (the fifth room).

Bog'liq darslar: school / the school, at sea / the sea — 74-dars; umumiy ma'nodagi otlar (life, history) — 75-dars; ovqatlanish (have lunch) va the top / the end — qizil kitob, 70-dars; davlat, daryo va tog' nomlari — 77-dars.

examples.title: One of a kind: **the** sun, **the** climate, **the** ocean
examples.description: Dunyoda bitta bo'lgan narsalar — the: the sun, the moon, the sky, the earth, the world, the climate, the atmosphere, the ocean.

sentences.text: **The sun** sets very early in December, so I hardly see daylight after work.
sentences.translation: Dekabrda **quyosh** juda erta botadi, shuning uchun ishdan keyin yorug'likni deyarli ko'rmayman.

sentences.text: Plastic bags are terrible for **the environment**, so many shops have stopped using them.
sentences.translation: Plastik paketlar **atrof-muhit** uchun juda zararli, shuning uchun ko'p do'konlar ulardan voz kechdi.

sentences.text: There wasn't a single star in **the sky** last night because of the dust.
sentences.translation: Kecha chang tufayli **osmonda** bitta ham yulduz yo'q edi.

sentences.text: Is it true that **the moon** affects the way we sleep?
sentences.translation: **Oy** uyqumizga ta'sir qilishi rostmi?

sentences.text: Scientists say **the climate** in Central Asia is getting hotter and drier.
sentences.translation: Olimlarning aytishicha, Markaziy Osiyoda **iqlim** tobora issiq va quruq bo'lib bormoqda.

sentences.text: Bekzod wants to travel around **the world** before he turns thirty.
sentences.translation: Bekzod o'ttiz yoshga to'lmasidan **dunyo** bo'ylab sayohat qilmoqchi.

sentences.text: About seventy per cent of **the earth's surface** is covered by water.
sentences.translation: **Yer yuzasining** qariyb yetmish foizini suv qoplagan.

sentences.text: We stood on the beach and watched the ships disappear over **the horizon**.
sentences.translation: Sohilda turib, kemalarning **ufqda** ko'zdan g'oyib bo'lishini kuzatdik.

sentences.text: Factories release tonnes of carbon dioxide into **the atmosphere** every day.
sentences.translation: Zavodlar har kuni **atmosferaga** tonnalab karbonat angidrid chiqaradi.

sentences.text: If we don't protect **the ocean**, there may be more plastic than fish in it by 2050, according to some reports.
sentences.translation: Ba'zi hisobotlarga ko'ra, **okeanni** asramasak, 2050 yilga kelib unda baliqdan ko'ra plastik ko'proq bo'lishi mumkin.

examples.title: Society: **the** government, **the** economy, **the** media
examples.description: Davlat va jamiyat darajasidagi yagona narsalar: the government, the economy, the capital, the public, the media, the press, the authorities, the army, the law.

sentences.text: **The government** plans to raise the minimum wage next year.
sentences.translation: **Hukumat** kelasi yil eng kam ish haqini oshirishni rejalashtirmoqda.

sentences.text: According to experts, **the economy** grew by six per cent last year.
sentences.translation: Mutaxassislarning ma'lumotiga ko'ra, o'tgan yili **iqtisodiyot** olti foizga o'sdi.

sentences.text: Tashkent is **the capital**, but Samarkand is older and, some say, more beautiful.
sentences.translation: Toshkent — **poytaxt**, lekin Samarqand qadimiyroq va, ba'zilarning fikricha, chiroyliroq.

sentences.text: Unfortunately, the museum is open to **the public** only at weekends.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, muzey **keng ommaga** faqat dam olish kunlari ochiq.

sentences.text: **The media** paid a lot of attention to the singer's wedding.
sentences.translation: **Ommaviy axborot vositalari** xonandaning to'yiga katta e'tibor qaratdi.

sentences.text: At the airport, the minister refused to answer questions from **the press**.
sentences.translation: Aeroportda vazir **matbuot** savollariga javob berishdan bosh tortdi.

sentences.text: Local people have asked **the authorities** to repair the bridge before winter.
sentences.translation: Mahalliy aholi **hokimiyatdan** qishgacha ko'prikni ta'mirlashni so'radi.

sentences.text: My cousin joined **the army** after school and is now an officer.
sentences.translation: Amakivachcham maktabdan keyin **armiyaga** borgan, hozir zobit.

sentences.text: Everyone is equal before **the law**, at least in theory.
sentences.translation: Hech bo'lmaganda nazariyada, **qonun** oldida hamma teng.

sentences.text: When **the national currency** falls, imported goods become more expensive almost overnight.
sentences.translation: **Milliy valyuta** qadrsizlanganda, import tovarlar deyarli bir kechada qimmatlashadi.

examples.title: **a** full moon, **a** better world, **a** new government
examples.description: Yagona narsaning bir holatini yoki turini sifat bilan tasvirlaganda — a / an: a full moon, a clear sky, a better world, a strong economy, a new government.

sentences.text: There was **a full moon** last night, so we walked home without a torch.
sentences.translation: Kecha **to'lin oy** bor edi, shuning uchun uyga fonarsiz qaytdik.

sentences.text: We woke up to **a clear blue sky** after three days of rain.
sentences.translation: Uch kunlik yomg'irdan keyin uyg'onsak, **osmon tip-tiniq va moviy** ekan.

sentences.text: Every parent dreams of **a better world** for their children.
sentences.translation: Har bir ota-ona farzandlari uchun **yaxshiroq dunyo** orzu qiladi.

sentences.text: The country needs **a stronger economy** to keep its young people at home.
sentences.translation: Yoshlarni yurtda olib qolish uchun mamlakatga **kuchliroq iqtisodiyot** kerak.

sentences.text: After the elections, **a new government** was formed within two weeks.
sentences.translation: Saylovdan keyin ikki hafta ichida **yangi hukumat** tuzildi.

sentences.text: As we drove back from Khiva, **a huge orange sun** was setting over the desert.
sentences.translation: Xivadan qaytayotganimizda, cho'l ustida **ulkan to'q sariq quyosh** botib borardi.

sentences.text: The ferry crossed **a rough, grey sea**, and half the passengers felt ill.
sentences.translation: Parom **to'lqinli, kulrang dengizni** kesib o'tdi, yo'lovchilarning yarmining ko'ngli aynidi.

sentences.text: We live in **a world** where everyone is online but nobody has time to talk.
sentences.translation: Hamma onlayn, lekin hech kimning gaplashishga vaqti yo'q **bir dunyoda** yashayapmiz.

sentences.text: It's hard to imagine **a society** without smartphones now.
sentences.translation: Endi smartfonsiz **jamiyatni** tasavvur qilish qiyin.

sentences.text: **The moon** was hidden all evening, but at midnight **a pale, thin moon** appeared between the clouds.
sentences.translation: Oqshom bo'yi **oy** ko'rinmadi, lekin yarim tunda bulutlar orasidan **oqish, ingichka oy** chiqdi.

examples.title: **the same**, **a similar**, **at the same time**
examples.description: the same doim the bilan: the same ... as, the same ... who / that, the same thing, at the same time, all the same. Lekin similar va different — a / an bilan.

sentences.text: Madina and I have worked in **the same office** for ten years.
sentences.translation: Madina bilan o'n yildan beri **bitta ofisda** ishlaymiz.

sentences.text: Your laptop is **the same model as** mine, but yours runs faster.
sentences.translation: Noutbuking **xuddi menikidek model**, lekin seniki tezroq ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Is that **the same man who** helped us at the station yesterday?
sentences.translation: Bu kecha vokzalda bizga yordam bergan **o'sha odammi**?

sentences.text: We had **a similar problem** with our neighbours last year.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili bizda ham qo'shnilarimiz bilan **shunga o'xshash muammo** bo'lgan.

sentences.text: You can't drive and send messages **at the same time** — it's illegal.
sentences.translation: Mashina haydab, **bir vaqtning o'zida** xabar yozish mumkin emas — bu qonunga zid.

sentences.text: Everyone in the team said **the same thing**: the deadline is impossible.
sentences.translation: Jamoadagi hamma **bir xil gapni** aytdi: muddatga ulgurib bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: The weather was awful, but we enjoyed the trip **all the same**.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo dahshatli edi, lekin **baribir** sayohatdan zavq oldik.

sentences.text: Twins don't always have **the same personality**, even if they look identical.
sentences.translation: Egizaklar bir-biriga juda o'xshasa ham, **xarakteri** doim **bir xil** bo'lavermaydi.

sentences.text: Sarah ordered **a different dish**, but in the end she wanted mine.
sentences.translation: Sara **boshqa taom** buyurtma qildi, lekin oxir-oqibat menikini xohlab qoldi.

sentences.text: If you take **the same bus** every morning, you start to recognise **the same faces** after a while.
sentences.translation: Har tong **bitta avtobusga** chiqsangiz, bir muddatdan keyin **o'sha-o'sha yuzlarni** taniy boshlaysiz.

examples.title: **the** cinema, **the** radio, **the** news — but **TV**
examples.description: Ko'ngilochar va axborot: go to the cinema / the theatre, on the radio, on the internet, the news, the papers — the bilan; watch TV, on TV — artiklsiz (the TV — apparatning o'zi).

sentences.text: We don't go to **the cinema** much now because everything is on streaming services.
sentences.translation: Endi **kinoga** kam boramiz, chunki hamma narsa striming xizmatlarida bor.

sentences.text: I heard about the accident on **the radio** while I was driving to work.
sentences.translation: Ishga ketayotib avariya haqida **radiodan** eshitdim.

sentences.text: My grandparents watch **TV** for hours, especially Turkish series.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvim soatlab **televizor** ko'rishadi, ayniqsa turk seriallarini.

sentences.text: Can you turn down **the TV**? I'm trying to sleep.
sentences.translation: **Televizorning** ovozini pasaytira olasanmi? Uxlashga harakat qilyapman.

sentences.text: Kate found her flat on **the internet**, without visiting it first.
sentences.translation: Keyt kvartirasini oldindan borib ko'rmasdan, **internet** orqali topdi.

sentences.text: Was there anything interesting on **the news** tonight?
sentences.translation: Bugun kechki **yangiliklarda** biror qiziq narsa bo'ldimi?

sentences.text: Have you ever been to **the theatre** in London's West End?
sentences.translation: Hech Londonning Vest-Endidagi **teatrlarga** borganmisiz?

sentences.text: Jasur's band played live on **TV** last Saturday, and the whole street watched.
sentences.translation: Jasurning guruhi o'tgan shanba kuni **televizorda** jonli ijro qildi, butun ko'cha tomosha qildi.

sentences.text: Most young people get their news online rather than from **the papers**.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik yoshlar yangiliklarni **gazetalardan** emas, internetdan oladi.

sentences.text: I'd rather go to **the gym** after work than sit in front of **the TV** all evening.
sentences.translation: Kechqurun bo'yi **televizor** oldida o'tirgandan ko'ra, ishdan keyin **sport zaliga** borganim ma'qul.

examples.title: **the** sea, **the** mountains, **the** countryside
examples.description: Tabiiy muhit turlari — the: go to the seaside, live by the sea, in the mountains, in the countryside, on the coast, in the desert. Transport sifatida esa — by sea.

sentences.text: Every summer we spend a week in **the mountains** near Chimgan.
sentences.translation: Har yozda Chimyon yaqinidagi **tog'larda** bir hafta dam olamiz.

sentences.text: Oliver grew up by **the sea**, so he's an excellent swimmer.
sentences.translation: Oliver **dengiz** bo'yida o'sgan, shuning uchun a'lo suzadi.

sentences.text: Life in **the countryside** is quieter, but there are fewer jobs.
sentences.translation: **Qishloqda** hayot tinchroq, lekin ish o'rinlari kamroq.

sentences.text: Shall we go to **the seaside** this weekend if the weather is nice?
sentences.translation: Ob-havo yaxshi bo'lsa, bu dam olish kuni **dengiz bo'yiga** boramizmi?

sentences.text: They bought a small cottage on **the coast** of Cornwall.
sentences.translation: Ular Kornuoll **sohilidan** kichik kottej sotib olishdi.

sentences.text: Temperatures in **the desert** can drop below zero at night.
sentences.translation: **Cho'lda** kechasi harorat noldan pastga tushishi mumkin.

sentences.text: My parents retired and moved to **the country** to grow their own vegetables.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam nafaqaga chiqib, o'zlari sabzavot yetishtirish uchun **qishloqqa** ko'chib ketishdi.

sentences.text: Is it cheaper to send furniture to Turkey **by sea** or by road?
sentences.translation: Turkiyaga mebelni **dengiz orqali** jo'natish arzonmi yoki quruqlik orqalimi?

sentences.text: We got lost in **the forest** and found the path only after dark.
sentences.translation: **O'rmonda** adashib qoldik va so'qmoqni faqat qorong'i tushgach topdik.

sentences.text: Although Uzbekistan has no access to **the sea**, people from Tashkent can reach **the beaches** of Turkey in four hours by plane.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistonning **dengizga** chiqish yo'li bo'lmasa ham, toshkentliklar Turkiya **plyajlariga** samolyotda to'rt soatda yetib olishadi.

examples.title: Play **the** piano, **Room** 214, **the** fifth floor
examples.description: Musiqa asboblari — the bilan (play the piano, learn the dutar); sport — artiklsiz. Ot + raqam — the siz (Room 214, Gate 7, page 52), tartib son + ot — the bilan (the fifth floor).

sentences.text: Dilnoza has been learning **the piano** since she was six.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza olti yoshidan beri **pianino** chalishni o'rganib kelyapti.

sentences.text: My grandfather played **the dutar** at every family wedding.
sentences.translation: Bobom har bir oilaviy to'yda **dutor** chalardi.

sentences.text: Tom plays **tennis** at weekends and **the guitar** in a band.
sentences.translation: Tom dam olish kunlari **tennis** o'ynaydi, guruhda esa **gitara** chaladi.

sentences.text: Your room is **Room 214**, on **the second floor**, next to the lift.
sentences.translation: Xonangiz — **214-xona**, **ikkinchi qavatda**, lift yonida.

sentences.text: Flight HY 201 to Tashkent is now boarding at **Gate 7**.
sentences.translation: Toshkentga uchadigan HY 201 reysiga **7-chiqish** orqali o'tirish boshlandi.

sentences.text: Open your books at **page 52** and look at **the third exercise**.
sentences.translation: Kitoblaringizni **52-betdan** oching va **uchinchi mashqqa** qarang.

sentences.text: Trains to Oxford leave from **Platform 4** every half an hour.
sentences.translation: Oksfordga poyezdlar har yarim soatda **4-platformadan** jo'naydi.

sentences.text: Do you have these trainers in **size 43**?
sentences.translation: Bu krossovkalarning **43-o'lchami** bormi?

sentences.text: My great-grandfather fought in **the Second World War** and came home in 1946.
sentences.translation: Katta bobom **Ikkinchi jahon urushida** qatnashgan va 1946 yilda uyga qaytgan.

sentences.text: Patients in **Ward 6** can have visitors only between four and six in the afternoon.
sentences.translation: **6-palatadagi** bemorlarni faqat kunduzi soat to'rtdan oltigacha kelib ko'rish mumkin.

examples.title: Mixed: **the** or no **the**?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: yagona narsa, a + sifat, space / nature / TV kabi the siz so'zlar, the same, tabiiy muhit.

sentences.text: Yuri Gagarin was the first person to travel into **space**, in 1961.
sentences.translation: Yuriy Gagarin 1961 yilda **koinotga** uchgan birinchi inson edi.

sentences.text: My children spend more time in front of screens than in **nature**.
sentences.translation: Bolalarim **tabiat** qo'ynida emas, ko'proq ekran oldida vaqt o'tkazishadi.

sentences.text: From **the top** of the tower you can see **the whole city** and even **the mountains**.
sentences.translation: Minoraning **tepasidan** **butun shahar** va hatto **tog'lar** ham ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: We had **lunch** in a small café and then went to **the theatre**.
sentences.translation: Kichkina kafeda **tushlik** qildik, keyin **teatrga** bordik.

sentences.text: **The nature** of the job means that I often work at weekends.
sentences.translation: Ishning **xususiyati** shundayki, ko'pincha dam olish kunlari ham ishlayman.

sentences.text: Astronauts on the space station see **the sun** rise sixteen times a day.
sentences.translation: Kosmik stansiyadagi astronavtlar kuniga o'n olti marta **quyosh** chiqishini ko'rishadi.

sentences.text: Did you watch the interview with the president on **TV** last night?
sentences.translation: Kecha **televizorda** prezident bilan suhbatni ko'rdingmi?

sentences.text: Aziz and Jasur grew up in **the same village**, but they met for the first time in London.
sentences.translation: Aziz va Jasur **bitta qishloqda** o'sgan, lekin ilk bor Londonda tanishishgan.

sentences.text: It was **a cold, grey day**, and **the sea** looked dangerous.
sentences.translation: **Sovuq, kulrang kun** edi, **dengiz** esa xavfli ko'rinardi.

sentences.text: When **the internet** went down, the whole office stopped working, and we realised how much we depend on it.
sentences.translation: **Internet** uzilganda butun ofis ishdan to'xtadi va biz unga qanchalik bog'liq ekanimizni angladik.
